text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 1 पर कविता पढ़ो, फिर जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 1 par kavita padho, phir jawab do.
text.en: Read the poem on page 1 of your book, then answer.

steps.question: Why do we wish for another chance?

questionMeaning.hi: हम एक और मौक़े की इच्छा क्यों करते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Hum ek aur mauke ki ichchha kyon karte hain?

options: To make a fresh beginning and correct our mistakes.
steps.answer: To make a fresh beginning and correct our mistakes.
steps.modelAnswer: We wish for another chance to make a fresh beginning, to blot out our mistakes and to change failure into winning.

modelMeaning.hi: हम एक और मौक़ा चाहते हैं ताकि नई शुरुआत कर सकें, गलतियाँ मिटा सकें और हार को जीत में बदल सकें।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Hum ek aur mauka chahte hain taaki nayi shuruaat kar sakein, galtiyaan mita sakein aur haar ko jeet mein badal sakein.

steps.question: What does it take to make a brand new start?

questionMeaning.hi: नई शुरुआत के लिए क्या चाहिए?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Nayi shuruaat ke liye kya chahiye?

options: a deep desire to try with all our heart
steps.answer: a deep desire to try with all our heart
steps.modelAnswer: It does not take a new day to make a brand new start. It only takes a deep desire to try with all our heart.

modelMeaning.hi: नई शुरुआत के लिए नया दिन ज़रूरी नहीं। बस पूरे दिल से कोशिश करने की गहरी इच्छा चाहिए।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Nayi shuruaat ke liye naya din zaroori nahi. Bas poore dil se koshish karne ki gehri ichchha chahiye.

steps.question: What does the poet mean by ‘adding a little sunshine to the world’?

questionMeaning.hi: ‘दुनिया में थोड़ी धूप जोड़ने’ का मतलब क्या है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: ‘Duniya mein thodi dhoop jodne’ ka matlab kya hai?

options: spreading happiness and kindness around us
steps.answer: spreading happiness and kindness around us
steps.modelAnswer: By adding a little sunshine, the poet means spreading happiness, love and kindness in the world around us.

modelMeaning.hi: थोड़ी धूप जोड़ने का मतलब है हमारे आसपास ख़ुशी, प्यार और दया फैलाना।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Thodi dhoop jodne ka matlab hai hamare aaspaas khushi, pyaar aur daya phailaana.

steps.question: Why should we never give up in despair?

questionMeaning.hi: हमें निराशा में हार क्यों नहीं माननी चाहिए?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Humein niraasha mein haar kyon nahi maanni chahiye?

options: There is always a tomorrow and hope of starting anew.
steps.answer: There is always a tomorrow and hope of starting anew.
steps.modelAnswer: We should never give up in despair because there is always a tomorrow and the hope of starting anew.

modelMeaning.hi: हमें निराशा में हार नहीं माननी चाहिए क्योंकि हमेशा एक कल होता है और नए सिरे से शुरू करने की उम्मीद रहती है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Humein niraasha mein haar nahi maanni chahiye kyonki hamesha ek kal hota hai aur naye sire se shuru karne ki ummeed rehti hai.

steps.question: What should we hope for our future?

questionMeaning.hi: हमें अपने भविष्य के लिए क्या उम्मीद करनी चाहिए?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Humein apne bhavishya ke liye kya ummeed karni chahiye?

steps.modelAnswer: We should hope for a new and better start, and live a little better every day.

modelMeaning.hi: हमें एक नई और बेहतर शुरुआत की उम्मीद करनी चाहिए और हर दिन थोड़ा बेहतर जीना चाहिए।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Humein ek nayi aur behtar shuruaat ki ummeed karni chahiye aur har din thoda behtar jeena chahiye.

instruction.en: (B) Match the lines of the poem
